title: Resolution urging Albany to pass the Next-Gen Civics Act
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, A.9298 and a Senate companion bill enacting the Next-Gen Civics Act. The law would require hands-on, project-based civic education for students in grades nine through 12 statewide. The resolution cites low youth voter turnout in New York City and uneven participation in the state's voluntary Seal of Civic Readiness program as reasons for action.
